items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: So then I joined Buddy Rich's small band. ... We had Rocky Calucci on piano who was the musical director for Patty Page for years

ctx.x: Yes, that was a small band, wasn't it?

Small band. Went with Herbie Fields and then I played around Philadelphia and New York, Providence, Rhode Island, all around the East Coast. Then I went with Jazz at the Philharmonic. I did that for about two years. Because it only lasted about six weeks a year at that time, anyway, you know, steady. So then I joined Buddy Rich's small band. We played at the Pop City, Royal Roost, played at Philadelphia, the Strand in Boston, around the East Coast, every place, you know. Zoot Sims and I were roommates. He had two…
But Zoot and I, we played with Buddy for a long time. And then I free lanced around New York, played the Apollo with different bands like Stan Getz, when he had a band to go in there.
